title: Adopted replacement for the B3 ratio statistic, with a development and validation split over standing poses
status: adopted prospectively; validation evaluated once and FAILED; the validation set is spent

supersedes.what_does_not_change: No verdict is withdrawn. The v4 B3 criterion remains on the record as failed by MOTOR-04 at 2 of 7 development poses, the v3 matrix remains 0 of 30 on the absolute cap, and both stand as recorded rather than being re-scored.
supersedes.superseded_text_before_adoption: Until 2026-09-09 this contract carried the line 'This contract supersedes nothing ... Nothing here changes any verdict.' That was true while it was unadopted and is no longer true of the criterion, though it remains true of every recorded verdict. The original line is preserved here rather than deleted.

why_this_exists.summary: The v4 B3 criterion measures whether standing displacement at 6 s is less than 1.5 times displacement at 3 s. A station-keeping controller was then built (MOTOR-04) and measured across seven settled poses. B3 turns out not to measure what it claims to, and this contract records the statistic that would, so that the alternative is written down before anyone decides whether to adopt it.

demonstrations_that_b3_is_degenerate.claim: B3 fails a strictly better controller and passes a worse one
demonstrations_that_b3_is_degenerate.note: The better controller is better at 3 s, better at 12 s and better at every pose tested. The ratio worsens because its denominator shrank.

demonstrations_that_b3_is_degenerate.claim: B3 passes a case that is leaking badly, because its window is too short
B3 passes a controller that has lost the body entirely
demonstrations_that_b3_is_degenerate.configuration: station-keeping with a rate term at gain 0.03 rad per mm/s
demonstrations_that_b3_is_degenerate.note: Twelve body lengths of travel and 154 degrees of rotation satisfy the criterion. This is the decisive case: a criterion a 30 mm runaway can satisfy is not a criterion on bounded drift.

why_this_exists.defect_class: A criterion satisfiable by a degenerate outcome. The project has repaired three of these before: ADR-2026-006 replaced a shuffled control that could not fail, and ADR-2026-009 plus the widened-sweep v2 contract corrected two criteria satisfied by degenerate outcomes. The v4 contract was itself the third such correction, which is exactly why this one was written unadopted, reported with its own expected failures, and adopted only as a separate explicit decision.

disclosure.not_blind: Every number in this contract was measured before it was written, and the controller registered as MOTOR-04 would pass the proposed criterion at 5 of the 7 poses tested and fail at 2 of them (heading -0.6 rad at 3.163 mm and heading +1.57 rad at 3.038 mm). That is stated up front because it is the point: the proposed criterion is not one the current controller passes. Adopting it would not close Track A, it would relocate the failure to a statistic that can be believed.
disclosure.who_decides: Not the author of the controller, and not in the same commit that reports the controller. Adoption was taken as a separate explicit project decision on 2026-09-09, with the v4 B3 failure and the three demonstrations already on the record, and with the disclosure above stating that the adopted criterion is one the current controller fails at 2 of 7 development poses.
disclosure.reviewer_instruction: A reviewer should check three things. First, that the three demonstrations reproduce, in particular D3, since it is the one that settles the argument. Second, that the proposed criterion is not merely easier: it must reject the uncontrolled baseline, and it must reject at least one configuration the current controller produces, or it is criterion-shopping wearing a longer horizon. Third, that adopting it does not withdraw the v4 verdict, which stands as a failure either way.

what_stays_unchanged: B1, the paired differential on the grooming replay, limit 2.5 mm
B2, standing displacement at the bout duration, limit 2.5 mm
B4, the pre-groom seek minimum, 0.5 mm
the renderer timing amendment at 100 ms
the requirement that acceptance needs every criterion, not the new one alone
claim_boundary: Criteria, a registered split and one evaluated validation set. Adopting B3-v5 changed no earlier verdict, awarded no tier and, having been evaluated, did not produce one: Track A remains not an accepted milestone. B2 passes on 12 of 12 unseen poses, B3-v5 fails at 8 of 12, B1 and B4 are unmeasured, the nine controls are not re-run, and the renderer timing amendment fails.
adopted_by: Explicit project decision, taken after the v4 B3 failure was reported and the three demonstrations below were on the record. The decision was not taken by the author of the controller in the commit that reported the failure, which is the sequencing the disclosure below asked for.

adoption_terms.prospective_only: B3-v5 governs runs executed after adoption. It re-scores nothing.
earlier_verdicts_preserved_unchanged: The v3 acceptance matrix failed 0 of 30 on the absolute 2.5 mm cap during a 3-second bout. That result stands, is not withdrawn, and is not re-scored.

The v4 B3 ratio criterion is failed by MOTOR-04 at 2 of 7 development poses. That result stands as recorded, and the demonstrations that its statistic is degenerate stand alongside it rather than erasing it.
stage2-exit-gate-v4 remains 0 of 3 and is untouched by this adoption.
Track A remains not an accepted milestone. Adopting a criterion is not passing it, and B1 and B4 remain unmeasured.
adoption_terms.what_b3_v5_replaces: The v4 B3 measure only. B1, B2 and B4 keep their statements and their 2.5 mm and 0.5 mm limits, the nine controls are unchanged, and the renderer timing amendment at 100 ms is unchanged and still fails.
adoption_terms.v4_b3_is_retained_as_a_reported_diagnost: The 6 s over 3 s ratio continues to be computed and reported at every run. It is no longer a criterion, because a 30.8 mm runaway satisfies it, but removing the number would hide the settling behaviour it does describe.

development_and_validation_split.why: Every pose MOTOR-04 has been measured on was also used to choose its gains, its control channel and its offset limit. So the recorded figures are training performance and cannot support a claim about a pose the controller has not seen. This split is registered before any tuning, so the validation set cannot be chosen after the fact.

development_poses.note: the only development pose that moved the dust patch

development_and_validation_split.development_use_permitted: MOTOR-04's gains, control channel, offset limits and settle window may be tuned against the development poses without limit. Everything already recorded in docs/evidence/TRACK_A_STATION_KEEPING.md was.

validation_set_rule.generator: numpy.random.default_rng(20260910), drawn in order, before any further tuning of MOTOR-04
validation_set_rule.held_fixed: initial_x_mm at the registered 0.0 and every other BODY-01 value at its registered value, including the dust patch, so no validation pose moves the arena
validation_set_rule.rounding: heading and y rounded to 4 decimal places
validation_set_rule.rejection: a draw whose construction raises the settled-outside-dust guard is discarded and replaced by the next draw, up to 40 attempts; the number discarded is reported
validation_set_rule.overlap_with_development: The draw is independent of the development set and near-coincidence in heading is possible. It is not excluded, because a pose the controller's result has never been seen on is a valid test whatever its heading, and adding an exclusion rule would be a free parameter.

freeze_and_evaluate_once.freeze: MOTOR-04 and this contract are committed before the validation run. The frozen commit is recorded in the validation artifact and the run requires a clean worktree.
freeze_and_evaluate_once.evaluate_once: The validation set is evaluated exactly once and the outcome is reported whatever it is.
freeze_and_evaluate_once.no_retuning_after_seeing_it: If validation fails, that is the reported result. Tuning against it afterwards would make it development data, so any further tuning requires a new validation set drawn from a new registered seed, and the failed validation stays on the record.

validation_acceptance_threshold.threshold: at least 10 of the 12 validation poses must satisfy B3-v5
validation_acceptance_threshold.where_it_comes_from: The v3 acceptance matrix requires at least 8 successes of 10 seeds per food position, which is 80 percent. Ten of twelve is the same 80 percent standard applied to poses, so the threshold is inherited from the existing matrix rather than invented here.
validation_acceptance_threshold.disclosure_that_it_is_informed: This threshold was written after the development results were seen, so it is not blind. It is set at a level the development set FAILS: MOTOR-04 satisfies B3-v5 at 5 of 7 development poses, which is 71 percent and below 80. So the threshold cannot have been chosen to be passable, which is the only property that matters here.
validation_acceptance_threshold.b2_threshold: B2, standing displacement at 3 s within 2.5 mm, is scored on the same 80 percent standard. MOTOR-04 satisfies it at 7 of 7 development poses.
validation_acceptance_threshold.expected_outcome_stated_before_the_run: On development performance of 5 of 7, the expected validation pass count is about 8 or 9 of 12, which would fail the threshold. This is written down before the validation run so that the outcome cannot be presented as a surprise either way.

development_and_validation_split.secondary_channel_attempt: MOTOR-04 gained an optional second fore-aft channel during development and it is registered disabled at weight 0.0. Coxa roll at weight -1.0 improved the three poses it was swept over and was worse on the full seven, at 3 of 7 passing against 5 of 7. The development set is what refuted it; no validation pose was involved.

adopted_criterion.name: standing drift is bounded at four times the bout duration
adopted_criterion.statement: The body must not translate more than one adult body length while standing under no descending command for four times the duration of a grooming bout, with all six legs adhered.
adopted_criterion.measure: net thorax displacement over a 12-second window with zero forward and yaw drive and no grooming command
adopted_criterion.limit_rationale: One adult Drosophila body length, the same limit as B1 and B2, derived from body length and not from any measured run. The horizon is four bout durations, which is long enough that a constant leak at the diagnosed 0.88 mm/s reaches 10.6 mm and fails by a factor of four.
adopted_criterion.why_this_is_well_conditioned: It is an absolute bound rather than a ratio, so it has no small denominator to divide by, and it cannot be satisfied by making the early measurement worse. Longer is strictly harder, which is the direction 'does not accumulate without bound' should point in.

would_reject_all_three_degenerate_cases.D1_worse_controller_note: not measured at 12 s under the same build; the comparison D1 rests on is at 3 s and 6 s

adopted_criterion.scored_on: the registered validation poses, reported per pose and as the count passing; the development poses are reported alongside and labelled as development

validation_outcome.verdict: B2 passes 12 of 12; B3-v5 passes 8 of 12 against 10 required, so validation FAILS
validation_outcome.predicted_before_the_run: about 8 or 9 of 12, which would fail
validation_outcome.development_versus_validation: Development 5 of 7 is 71 percent and validation 8 of 12 is 67 percent, the same rate within the resolution of twelve samples. Had the controller been overfitted to the development poses the validation rate would have collapsed and it did not, so this is a capability limit at the twelve-second horizon rather than an overfitting gap. All four failures are late-time leaks; v04 holds to 0.088 mm at 3 s, the tightest in the set, and reaches 3.634 mm at 12 s.
validation_outcome.preserved_exactly: This outcome is not revised, rescored or reinterpreted. The twelve poses may not be tuned against and may not be evaluated a second time, and flysim refuses both: seed 20260910 is listed in flysim.station_validation.SPENT_VALIDATION_SEEDS, which the draw consults. The poses can still be redrawn for inspection under an explicit reproduce purpose, which produces no artifact.
validation_outcome.v4_ratio_diagnostic: The retired 6 s over 3 s ratio would have passed only 3 of 12 and disagrees with the adopted criterion on half the set, including passing v08 at 1.285 while v08 has drifted 2.601 mm. That is the fourth independent demonstration that the ratio does not measure bounded drift.

future_development_rule.why_a_new_id: MOTOR-04 is frozen at the values it was validated under, and its validation failed. Changing those values in place would make the recorded failure unattributable to any controller, so a successor is a new registered assumption rather than an edit.
requirements: A new development set, drawn from a newly registered seed and registered in plaintext before any tuning begins, because it is meant to be tuned against. The seven poses that chose MOTOR-04's gains may be reused as development, since they are already training data and cannot become less so.

A separately frozen validation set whose seed is registered as a COMMITMENT rather than in plaintext, under motor-05-validation-protocol-v1. This contract registered seed 20260910 in plaintext, which fixed the set in advance and left the poses drawable by whoever was tuning; the holdout rested on discipline rather than on the protocol.

The commitment records what it establishes. A digest proves the seed was fixed before the freeze whoever holds the secret; it proves the poses were unseen during tuning only if the secret was held by another party or the seed came from a public source whose value postdated the freeze. A single-party commitment is labelled blinding 'none' and must not be called a blind holdout.

The development seed and the validation commitment are registered in the same commit, before tuning, so neither can be chosen after a result is seen, and the reveal trigger is named then too so the reveal cannot be timed to suit a result.
The seeds are distinct from each other and from 20260910, and 20260910 stays permanently retired.
Evaluation once, reported whatever it is, exactly as this contract required, from a clean worktree verified by re-hashing the file bytes and preferably from a detached worktree at the freeze commit.
future_development_rule.what_stays_on_the_record: This failed validation, whatever MOTOR-05 achieves. A later success does not withdraw an earlier failure; it is a second result about a different controller.
future_development_rule.attempt_number: MOTOR-05 is the second attempt. Repeated attempts each with a fresh holdout would eventually produce a pass by selection across attempts, so every successor reports which number it is.
